import FreeCAD
import Part

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("TorusDocument")

# Create a torus with major radius 5 mm and minor radius 2 mm

# - MajorRadius (R): distance from center of tube to center of torus
# - MinorRadius (r): radius of the tube itself
torus = Part.makeTorus(5, 2)  # major_radius=5, minor_radius=2

# Create a shape object in the document
shape_obj = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Torus")
shape_obj.Shape = torus

# Set the appearance to Wood using Material properties

    # Try to set Wood material

        # Get the material manager

        # Set the material to Wood
        shape_obj.Material = {'Name': 'Wood'}
    except Exception as e:

# Alternative approach: Set display color/appearance via ViewProvider

# Verify the torus properties
